descriptions.value: The FormFlow for GoHighLevel (GHL)  WordPress plugin through 1.0.0 does not restrict access to a log file it writes inside the publicly accessible uploads directory, allowing unauthenticated attackers to read its contents, which include connected-CRM identifiers and, on sites that have linked the integration, a third-party access token.

assertions.title: FormFlow for GoHighLevel <= 1.0.0 - Unauthenticated Sensitive Data Disclosure via Log File

descriptions.description: CWE-200 Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

title: FormFlow for GoHighLevel <= 1.0.0 - Unauthenticated Sensitive Data Disclosure via Log File
